args.subject: Certificate of origin needed: HR-40220 actuator, HPO-26-00442/10 and HPO-26-00656/20
args.body:
Hello,

We need proof of origin for the electric linear actuator, 48 V, 6 kN, 200 mm stroke (HR-40220), on our open lines:

- HPO-26-00442/10, 84 EA, promised 28 September
- HPO-26-00656/20, 87 EA, promised 27 November

Please send:
1. A certificate of origin stating the country where the actuator is made.
2. The HTS classification you use for it. Our file shows 8501314000.
3. The ship date for HPO-26-00656/20, as soon as it is known.

We need the certificate by 15 October. Please also confirm the status of HPO-26-00442/10, which was promised 28 September.

Thank you,
Halden Robotics Purchasing

recommendation.finding: The origin of the electric linear actuator (HR-40220) is blank on file, so nothing is owed yet. If it is made in China, the 25% duty from 1 November would be $50K net on the open orders and the uncovered 12-month need ($77K gross). Halden is importer of record on both open lines. HPO-26-00442/10 (84 EA, promised 28 September) enters before 1 November. HPO-26-00656/20 (87 EA, promised 27 November) owes nothing only if it ships before 1 November and enters before 1 December, and no ship date is recorded. I staged a request to Linfield Linear Motion for a certificate of origin and the ship date, wanted by 15 October. It waits for approval. The five-part origin item linked to this one is the same actuator.
